lessons.label: Lesson
lessons.hubSubtitle: Master the fundamentals of smart investing

goalBased.title: Why Goal-Based Investing?
goalBased.point1: Traditional investing asks: "How much risk can you handle?" We ask: "What are you dreaming of?"
goalBased.point2: Each goal gets its own timeline and strategy. Your wedding fund shouldn't ride the same rollercoaster as your retirement.
goalBased.point3: When markets crash, you'll know exactly which goals are safe and which have time to recover.
goalBased.takeaway: 💡 Takeaway: Goals first, investments second. Your money serves your dreams—not the other way around.

timeHorizon.title: The Magic of Time Horizon
timeHorizon.point1: Short-term money (0-3 years): Keep it safe. A 30% crash right before your wedding? No thanks.
timeHorizon.point2: Mid-term money (3-10 years): Some risk is OK. You have time to recover from dips.
timeHorizon.point3: Long-term money (10+ years): Go for growth! History shows markets always recover over decades.
timeHorizon.takeaway: 💡 Takeaway: Time is your superpower. The longer you can wait, the more risk (and reward) you can handle.

diversification.title: Diversification: Your Safety Net
diversification.point1: Don't put all your eggs in one basket. When tech stocks crash, bonds might shine.
diversification.point2: Our bucket system is diversification on steroids. Short-term = safe, Long-term = growth.
diversification.point3: Even in 2008's worst crash, diversified portfolios recovered faster than all-stock portfolios.
diversification.takeaway: 💡 Takeaway: Diversification can't prevent losses, but it can prevent catastrophe.

compoundGrowth.title: Compound Growth: The 8th Wonder
compoundGrowth.point1: ₪1,000/month at 8% for 30 years = ₪1.5 million. You only put in ₪360,000!
compoundGrowth.point2: The secret: your money makes money, which makes MORE money. Snowball effect.
compoundGrowth.point3: Starting 10 years earlier can mean DOUBLE the final amount. Time beats everything.
compoundGrowth.takeaway: 💡 Takeaway: Start today. The best time to invest was yesterday. The second best time is now.

stayingCourse.title: The Hardest Part: Staying the Course
stayingCourse.point1: In 2008, those who sold at the bottom locked in 50% losses forever.
stayingCourse.point2: Those who held? Fully recovered in 18 months and went on to new highs.
stayingCourse.point3: Our bucket system helps: when markets crash, your Short-term bucket is safe. Sleep easy.
stayingCourse.takeaway: 💡 Takeaway: The market will test you. Your plan is designed to handle it. Trust the process.
